about: Notable planets pinned on the Galaxy map. Names match the exoplanet.eu rows in exoplanet_map.json; distance, discovery year and method on the page come from that dataset, not from this file. Each tagline is supported by the reference given. Entries marked showcase are the one-per-method set (transit, radial velocity, imaging, microlensing, astrometry, timing). All DOIs were checked against Crossref on 18 Oct 2026.

planets.name: 51 Peg b
planets.tagline: The first planet found around a Sun-like star.

planets.name: KELT-9 Ab
planets.tagline: Among the hottest known planets: its dayside is near 4,600 K.

planets.name: WASP-121 b
planets.tagline: A hot Jupiter with metals escaping from its upper atmosphere.

planets.name: beta Pic b
planets.tagline: A directly imaged giant inside its star's debris disc.

planets.name: TOI-700 d
planets.tagline: An Earth-size planet in its star's habitable zone.

planets.name: GJ 1214 b
planets.tagline: A small transiting planet whose low density first suggested a water-rich world.

planets.name: b Cen (AB)b
planets.tagline: A super-Jupiter imaged around a binary star.

planets.name: Proxima Centauri b
planets.tagline: Orbits Proxima Centauri, the nearest star to the Sun.

planets.name: TRAPPIST-1 e
planets.tagline: Earth-size, one of seven planets around TRAPPIST-1.

planets.name: pi Men c
planets.tagline: Found by TESS; exoplan's run recovered its transits.

planets.name: Kepler-40 b
planets.tagline: A hot Jupiter transiting an evolved F-type star, confirmed with SOPHIE radial velocities.

planets.name: OGLE-2012-BLG-0026L b
planets.tagline: One of a pair of giant planets found together by microlensing.

planets.name: PSR B1257+12 b
planets.tagline: Among the first planets found beyond the Sun, by timing a millisecond pulsar.

planets.name: GJ 896 Ab
planets.tagline: Found from its red-dwarf host's astrometric wobble, in a binary star system.

planets.name: BD+20 2457 b
planets.tagline: A very massive companion to an evolved K giant star, found by radial velocity.

planets.name: HD 189733 Ab
planets.tagline: A hot Jupiter whose deep-blue colour was measured with Hubble.

planets.name: Barnard's star b
planets.tagline: A sub-Earth-mass planet around Barnard's Star, one of the Sun's nearest neighbours.
planets.ref_label: González Hernández et al. 2024, A&A 690, A79
